about_the_game:
Milfy Cases: Damsels in Distress
A recent graduate of The Academy, Scott Thunderstone (name customizable) is on a mission to track down and recover a
magical artifact in the small town of Hope Springs.

On arrival, Scott meets his new partner, Detective McBrighton, while on a case investigating a burglary at the Winthrope
Manor. Mary Winthrope meets Scott and discovers he has yet to secure lodging in town, inviting him to stay at the manor.
Her maids, Sally and Alice, both make an entrance, and pose different kinds of distraction for Scott while he's on the case.
Will he be able to find the missing artifact and track down a rogue agent? Find out in this urban fantasy visual novel.

As you take the role of Scott, you will make choices that tie to comedy, aggression, and inquiry, as well as earn in game achievements, unlock lore, and explore the the first act of this exciting story in development.
